key_insight: Reliable use of biological foundation models requires understanding their knowledge boundaries: the inputs, tasks, and conditions under which their outputs can be trusted.
engineering_relevance: Agentic research systems need explicit model-limit descriptions to guide tool selection and avoid using biological predictions beyond validated conditions.
method: Frame model reliability through knowledge boundaries.
Examine five defining elements: data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis.
Review successes and failures and propose standardized descriptions of model limits.
evidence_signal: The review examines models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein measurements, and single-cell measurements, but the abstract reports no quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: An agent’s ability to call a foundation model does not establish that its outputs are reliable for the requested biological task.
paper_title: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
